scope: Exact speech models selected by Parlora; local transcript entries and encoded bytes are not provider tokens. Unknown means not established by the consulted official pages, not unlimited.

providers.notes: GPT-Live summarizes older history and replaces its voice engine within the session. The documented 2-hour connected-call limit applies to SIP; do not substitute the older Realtime API's limits for this model or infer a WebSocket duration.

The session-management guide describes unlimited duration with context compression and multiple connections via resumption. Parlora already requests compression and resumption; local compaction does not implement or extend remote connection lifetime.

The model and voice API pages do not establish a numeric context window or live-session duration. The 30-minute value is cached resumption-history inactivity expiry, not maximum call duration. Parlora's current adapter does not enable that resumption feature. Grok transcript item IDs, call records and command IDs retain separate local lifetime caps.

No token window or maximum conversation duration was established in the consulted model introduction and WebSocket/configuration pages. Agent inactivity settings and organization request-rate limits are distinct from history capacity. Parlora configures no_input_end_conversation_sec to 600; it does not implement the provider's conversation reset API.
